senses.gloss: (variously corrupted, the j sound being rendered by ג or כ) pr. n. m. Trajanus, the Roman emperor.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 18b:5">Taan. 18ᵇ</cite> (<he>טר׳</he> a. <he>טור׳</he>); <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 8:15">Treat. S’maḥoth ch. VIII</cite> <he>טרגיא׳</he>; Sifra Emor Par. 8, ch. IX <he>מריינוס</he> (corr. acc.); Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ top <cite ref="I00443"><he>טיריון</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ</cite> top <he>טרוגיונוס</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:19">ib. to IV, 19</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="I00833"><he>טרכינוס</he></cite>.
Ib. to III, 2; 4; a. e. (v. Joel, Blicke in die Religionsgesch. I, p. 17, sq.).—טְרָיָינִי (genitive of Trajanus) Trajan’s (followers). Ib. to I, 17 טרכיני, v. אִסְפַּסְיָינִי.
